verdict.rationale: Coinbase documents an official CDP CLI that powers payment workflows, such as USDC acceptance-to-treasury and USDC payouts. Its `cdp mcp` mode exposes every API endpoint as a tool, and a separate official Agentic Wallet CLI ships agent skills for fund, send, trade and monetize-service. A probe confirms the CLI documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and detailed install/command-reference coverage in the evidence.
